message: チェストなテスト

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, wake u~p. It's about to sta~rt」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haa!? No intention of heading to the battlefield!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「World history is tomorro~w」

name: Nanaka
message: 「NO WAY!?」

name: Synn
message: 「You sure seem relaxed, Sacchin...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Giving up is one kind of strategy, you kno~w」
I don't think that counts as preparation at all, though.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you all set, Azel?」
Azel said nothing and turned away.
Just like that, she put her head down on the desk.

name: Synn
message: 「Not even taking out any writing utensils--does she even care...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Worry about me instead of Aze~l」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't have the luxury to be worrying about other people」
Well, I've done everything I can. All I can do now is give it my best.

name: Synn
message: 「Haa... I'm exhausted...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm finished...」

name: Synn
message: 「We still have tomorrow, don't we?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean it's practically all over for me already!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's mean to take your frustration out on Synn-kun, you kno~w」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And how did you do, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I might be neck-and-neck with Nana-chan this ti~me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I really am finished...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hey~! I can't just let that sli~de!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up...」
Today's only a half-day of classes, so I wonder what I should do now.
